stale_status_note: stale current-state K1 wording in public files is handled by the stale-line rule of PUBLICATION_ALLOWLIST_R2.json, not by this wording scan (the correction form must quote the historical claim)
governing_negation_rule: take the LAST governing cue (not|no|never|without) in the normalized text before the match; the match is licensed iff no sentence punctuation [.;:!?] lies between that cue and the match and the text between them fully matches neutral_insertion_regex
